other_conditions: Must be a woman scientist or academician employed in a permanent position in a government institution, R&D lab, or university
Must be willing to resign from the permanent position or take a long leave to avail the fellowship and return to the parent organization after the tenure
The new location must be at least 500 km away from the current city
Relocation may be due to marriage, husband’s transfer, caring for ailing parents, or accompanying children studying elsewhere
benefits_summary: Awardees receive a monthly salary plus a research grant of ₹5,00,000 per annum for a maximum tenure of five years.
